主题：Probation Review Policy - Standard Periods
Team,

Standard probation review periods:
- All new hires: 90-day probation review
- Send reminders when within 30 days of the review date
- Flag as URGENT if the review date has passed

Managers may request extensions on a case-by-case basis. Check with the manager's communication channels for any approved extensions.

- HR Director"}
